data.name: Durjaya
data.gender_notes: Durjaya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Durjaya is a Sanskrit name that means 'invincible' or 'incomparable'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'dur' (difficult) and 'jaya' (victory). This name is often given to a child who is believed to possess the strength and courage to overcome challenges and emerge victorious. The name Durjaya carries the meaning “Invincible, Incomparable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Durjaya usually hope their child will grow to embody invincible, incomparable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the indomitable spirit of a warrior or a hero, embodying the qualities of bravery, determination, and unwavering resolve.
data.etymology: Durjaya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Invincible, Incomparable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Durjaya total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
